address: Lymington Rd, Milford on Sea, Lymington,SO41 0RF
bio: Nestled between the beautiful New Forest National Park and picturesque Hampshire coastline, The South Lawn Hotel is a county house retreat, only a short distance from the market town of Lymington.  Enjoy Afternoon Tea in The Cedar Tree Restaurant, with views across their manicured gardens. Indulge in a selection of sandwiches, cakes and scones served with clotted cream and jam along with a choice of tea or coffee.
